debit.sms: SMS BLKDC <space> <Cust ID> to 9840909000 from your registered mobile number
debit.notes: Call immediately on toll-free 1800 1200 (mobiles & landlines in India; contact-us lists it 8:00 AM-8:00 PM with only critical service post 8:00 PM, while the site footer calls it the 24/7 Contact Center) or chargeable 1860 210 1200. From outside India: +91 22 5079 5101 / 1833 380 0149 (USA) / 1833 491 0559 (Canada) / 8000 48 9153 (UK) / 8000 3570 2510 (UAE); the bank's Card Blocking Assistance PDF also lists +91 22 30993600 for debit calls from outside India. SMS block: BLKDC <space> <Cust ID> to 9840909000 from your registered mobile number (the page's tail text anomalously reads 'to block your Internet Banking'). NetBanking path: login, open the 'mySpace' tab, select 'Debit Cards', choose 'Hot List Debit Cards'. Mobile path (page names the app YES Mobile): download from Play Store/App Store, register, login with APIN/fingerprint, tap Debit Card from the bottom carousel, select 'Hot List Debit Cards', confirm with MPIN; the site footer's download badges link to iris by YES BANK (irisbyyesbank.page.link/MainDashboard). Hotlist email: debitcard@yesbank.in from your registered e-mail ID with your CUSTOMER ID and the last 4 digits of the debit card (fulfilled within 1 working day; the bank recommends its real-time channels for immediate blocking). The bank's page points to the National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in for unauthorized transactions.

credit.sms: SMS BLKCC <space> <Last 4 digits of card number> to +91 9840909000 from your registered mobile number
credit.notes: Call 1800 103 1212 (toll free for mobiles & landlines in India) or chargeable 1860 210 1200; from outside India +91 22 4935 0000. Marquee/Reserv/YES First customers: 1800 103 6000 (toll free). SMS block (Card Blocking Assistance PDF; the unauthorized-transaction page words it 'BLKCC <space> <Last 4 digit of Card Number> to 9840909000'): to +91 9840909000 from your registered mobile number. NetBanking path: login, open the 'Credit Card' tab, select 'Block Lost/Stolen Card'. iris by YES BANK app path: tap Credit card, click Manage, select 'Block card & Reissue', confirm blocking with MPIN; footer Play/App Store badges link to irisbyyesbank.page.link/MainDashboard. YES Pay path: Manage Cards, tap requests, select Block Card. Block email: creditcard.block@yesbank.in from your registered e-mail id. The bank's page points to the National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in for unauthorized transactions.

upi.notes: PhoneBanking is the bank's published freeze path for its UPI channel: 'To block NetBanking, Mobile Banking, YES Pay channels, YES Robot, YES TRANSACT Smart Pay or WhatsApp Banking, please make a call to the YES BANK PhoneBanking', and 'To report Debit Card / NetBanking / Mobile Banking / YES Robot / WhatsApp Banking / Prepaid Card / YES Pay transactions not done by you, call the YES BANK PhoneBanking' — YES Pay / YES Pay Next is Yes Bank's UPI app. PhoneBanking: 1860 210 1200 (charges apply) or 1800 1200 (toll free); from outside India +91 22 5079 5101 / 1833 380 0149 (USA) / 1833 491 0559 (Canada) / 8000 48 9153 (UK) / 8000 3570 2510 (UAE). 'Credit Line on UPI' product support: +91 (22) 5089 5333 (9:30 AM to 5:00 PM) / yestouchclou@yes.bank.in. National Cyber Crime helpline 1930 (cybercrime.gov.in) for unauthorized transactions. Caveats: no UPI-specific SMS keyword is published (BLKRNB/BLKMB/BLKDC/BLKCC/BLKROBOT/BLKWA cover NetBanking/Mobile Banking/cards/robot/WhatsApp only); no in-app UPI freeze menu path or NetBanking UPI disable path is published on official pages; androidApp is the bank's published Android download landing page for YES Pay Next (no Play Store/App Store URL published).
